children: According to Coinglass data, whales on the Hyperliquid platform currently hold $9.46 billion in positions, including $4.46 billion in long positions and $5.01 billion in short positions. According to ChainCatcher, long positions account for 47.11% of total holdings, while short positions account for 52.89%.

Long positions show $654 million in profit and loss, while short positions show a loss of $705 million. A whale address, 0x5b5d..60, is currently holding a 5x isolated short on ETH entered at $2,304.06, with an unrealized loss of $40.59 million.

title: Hyperliquid Whale Positions Reach $9.46 Billion, With Shorts Slightly Outweighing Longs
